global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and dark nori seaweed resting atop the noodles. Served in a white bowl with green patterns, it sits on a wooden table under warm, natural light.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with smooth, slightly reflective surface and visible grain patterns.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with green geometric and floral patterns along its rim and inner edge.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, light brown, glossy, thin strands swirling, topped with green onions and dark seaweed.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark, glossy, irregularly shaped, and has a rough, textured surface with visible folds and edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork has golden-brown, glistening surface with visible fat marbling and slightly charred edges.
